Evidence: We conducted a cross-sectional, laboratory-based sentinel study among ART-failing individuals from October 2022 through April 2023 at the "Chantal Biya" International Reference Centre, Yaoundé-Cameroon. Overall, 203 individuals were enrolled, median [IQR] age 37 [16-47] years with  (58.1% ) (118/203) being female.
